title: Self-employed?
5 things to do
before Jan 1
lead: Self-employed individuals generally have a December 31 year-end, so December is clean-up month.

items: Total your sales for each quarter
Write down your odometer on Dec 31
No receipt? Note who, what, when, $

blocks.text: CRA asks for each vehicle's odometer reading at the start and end of the fiscal period.
